title: AARANYA RIDGE
location: L10 · AARANYA RIDGE OBSERVATORY (exterior) → L11 · OLD OBSERVATORY WING
logline: A beautiful place with one wrong thing in it. The old wing is boarded up, and something blue is leaking through the gaps.
grade: Clean, high, cold daylight. Whites are bright but never clipped. The ONE blue is the light from the old wing — it must be the only unnatural colour in the scene.

narration.hi: आरण्य रिज। बादलों के नीचे बना एक शांत इमारत — जैसे पहाड़ ने खुद के लिए एक दरवाज़ा बनाया हो।
narration.en: Aaranya Ridge. A quiet building beneath the clouds — as if the mountain had made a door for itself.

narration.hi: पुरानी इमारत बंद थी। ताले पर जंग थी, दीवारों पर धूल। लेकिन उसी तरफ़ से नीली रोशनी आ रही थी।
narration.en: The old building was sealed. Rust on the lock, dust on the walls. But a blue light was coming from that side.

shots.cam: Drone, 200 m, approaching the ridge from the valley side, dome in the left third
shots.move: Slow forward push over the ridge crest; the building reveals itself over the horizon line.
shots.action: Cloud pours over the far ridge. The dome catches the sun. A small figure-scale bus is parked below.
shots.env: L10 observatory: white ribbed dome on a concrete-and-glass research block, single slit, solar panels on the roof, a gravel apron, wind-bent grass.
shots.light: Hard noon sun, short shadows, sky deep blue at the zenith fading pale at the horizon.
shots.vfx: Cloud sea, wind-blown grass, one bird at the top of frame.
shots.cont: A-11 ARCHITECTURE: the dome in S08-03's slide must match this exactly. Modern block runs east–west; the OLD WING is a separate stone structure 60 m north-west, half-abandoned. Never swap sides.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.60 m, at the gravel apron, bus in frame-left
shots.move: Static; students spill out of the door.
shots.action: Disembarking. Wind immediately messes everyone's hair and clothes. Two students chase a blown cap.
shots.expr: Awe, then immediate shivering and laughing.
shots.env: Gravel apron, low stone parapet, the modern building behind.
shots.light: Hard sun, high contrast; everyone squints. Do not correct the squinting — it's the honesty of the location.
shots.vfx: Dust kicked from the gravel, hair physics, one blown cap. Wind is a character in this scene.
shots.cont: Meera gets off last. That is a character beat, not a camera accident.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.50 m, wide-ish on the group with the teacher in the middle
shots.move: Slow 15° pan following the teacher's pointing hand toward the dome.
shots.action: The teacher gathers them with two raised hands and gestures at the dome, then at the path. Students bunch up around her.
shots.env: Apron, path to the dome, wind-bent grass at the edges.
shots.light: Hard noon; the teacher's shadow falls toward camera — this fixes the sun's direction for the whole location (SUN-LOCK A-11).
shots.cont: TEACHER stays with the group for the rest of Scene 11. She must NOT notice the boys slip away in S12 — she is occupied with a student's question.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.75 m, low angle from the path looking up at the research block
shots.move: Slow 25° tilt up from the entrance to the dome.
shots.action: Nothing moves. Architectural reveal only — glass, concrete, the ribbed dome, a single antenna.
shots.env: Modern building: three storeys, curtain-wall glazing, deep concrete reveals, a service door with a keypad.
shots.light: Glass reflects the cloud sea; the concrete is bright and neutral.
shots.vo: Silence. A breath of pure production design.
shots.cont: Do NOT put readable signage anywhere in this shot. The name exists in narration and in the episode title card.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.55 m, 3/4 behind Ishaan, the old wing across frame
shots.move: Static until the last 6 s, then a slow 12° drift toward the old wing — the camera leaning toward the mystery before he does.
shots.action: He turns away from the group. His attention catches on something off-axis. He takes half a step, stops, and looks properly.
shots.expr: The 'wait, what' face — brow gathering, mouth opening slightly.
shots.env: Old wing in the middle distance: stone walls, boarded windows, a rusted chain and padlock, a dead creeper, a collapsed gutter.
shots.light: The old wing is in shade — a full stop darker than everything else. Its shadow side faces camera.
shots.vfx: Wind-blown dust at the base of the wall.
shots.cont: L11 must read as OLD — but not gothic. Practical, institutional, forgotten. No cobwebs-cliché.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.55 m, 2.5 m from the boarded window, telephoto through the gap in the planks
shots.move: Very slow push-in, 0.1 m/s — an investigative move, not a horror move.
shots.action: Through a 4 cm gap between planks: darkness, dust suspended, and a faint, pulsing blue glow from below floor level.
shots.env: Boarded window: splintered timber, rusted nails, a stone sill with lichen.
shots.light: Daylight outside at 5 stops over the interior: the gap is almost white, the interior pure black, the blue glow the only other value.
shots.vfx: VFX HERO SHOT 1: a slow 2.4 s pulse of blue from a source below frame; dust motes drifting in the gap; no lens flare, no god rays.
shots.cont: The blue is #2F6DFF at 40% intensity, never neon, never a hard-edged beam. This is a leak, not a beacon. Locked as VFX-CORE-01.

shots.cam: Exterior, height 1.55 m, 3/4 on Ishaan's face, old wing behind him
shots.move: Static; a 2-frame head-turn and then absolute stillness.
shots.action: He looks directly at the boarded window. Nothing about his face changes except his eyes narrowing and his breathing stopping for a beat.
shots.expr: Recognition without understanding. This is the moment the episode's spine locks in.
shots.env: Old wing behind, out of focus, a dark shape in a bright frame.
shots.light: Sun on the left of his face; a barely perceptible blue bounce on his right cheek — the light is already touching him.
shots.vfx: A single, tiny blue specular in his left iris. 4 frames. Almost subliminal.
shots.vo: Silence. End scene on the iris. Hard cut.
shots.cont: Continuity supervisor: the specular must be in the LEFT iris only, matching the light source's position relative to the old wing.
